newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks to open mixed, lower on tech warnings.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks to open mixed, lower on tech warnings.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open mixed to lower Wednesday following earnings warnings by several high-profile computer companies.

Gateway 2000 Inc, a direct marketer of computers, and Seagate Technology Inc, a disk drive maker, are trading lower in U.S. pre-open trading. Both companies warned of lower-than-expected results after the bell Tuesday.
The 30-year long bond was off 5/32 with a 6.73 percent yield. The Standard & Poor's index futures were off 3.65 at 899.10.
